parameters.description: Keep exact tile footprint, 4:3 top and thin sidewalls. Remove ALL the repeated light corner triangles, dark corner seams and symmetrical decoration. Make the earth one quiet uniform muted brown-olive color, with only ONE broad very subtle soft-edged irregular patch near the back-left, no outline around it. 95% blank flat earth. No marks at the four corners. No speckles or texture, no gradients. Transparent outside tile.
